description: REQUIRES prior fourinsure__session__login call with same account_link_id. Submit a 4대보험 certificate application. IRREVERSIBLE: the application is filed with the 정보연계센터 and a receipt number is assigned; there is no cancel action. This writes to the institution. The first call is not executed: it returns a preview of exactly what will be sent and a one-time confirmation_token (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Show that preview to the user as it is. Only after the user agrees, call again with the same arguments plus that confirmation_token. Never add the token without the user's agreement. Changing any argument makes the token invalid; call without the token to get a new preview. 호출마다 토큰 1소진 요청 처리 시 XBOSS 작업을 생성하고 처리 결과를 저장합니다. 기관 원본의 조회 여부와 별개로 이 호출은 순수 읽기 전용이 아닙니다. 기관 데이터 변경은 도구별 실행 내용과 기존 확인 절차를 따릅니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

confirm_submit.description: Dry-run selector, NOT the write confirmation (that is the one-time confirmation_token). false validates the payload without submitting. Default true.

confirmation_token.description: One-time confirmation token returned by the first call (error WRITE_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED). Send it back unchanged with the same arguments to execute; it expires in 10 minutes and works once.

dry_run.description: true returns the prepared payload without submitting. Default false.

selection.description: Certificate selection key from apply.init ('3'=사업장 가입자 명부, else 사업장 가입내역 확인서)
